story.title: Story 4: Size Guidance, Retry, And Escalation

result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 4’s size-guidance, retry/escalation, lean-artifact, and builder-accounting implementation across the lower-band compression service/provider, semantic accounting helpers, token counters, and their supporting tests/artifacts.

newFindings.title: Semantic lower-band accounting still keeps a live placeholder fallback in production code
newFindings.evidence: Story 4’s design requires `detailed_chunk_materialized` / `brief_chunk_materialized` accounting to read semantic artifact text under `chunk.lowerBand`, not placeholder text under `chunk.placeholders` (tech design Q3; test plan ‘Semantic counter rewiring’ and the runtime-path note that placeholder fallback must be impossible). The implementation still leaves that compatibility path live: `src/thread/async-thread/domain/chunk-state.ts:83-106` returns placeholder artifacts from `getReadyChunkLowerBandArtifact`, `src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:315-336` accepts `artifact.kind === "placeholder"` in `resolveChunkSemanticArtifactAccounting`, `src/token-accounting/materialized-representation-counter.ts:243-260` and `src/token-accounting/openai-input-token-counter.ts:423-440` both fall back to `chunk.placeholders.*.text`, and `src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:1476-1521` still re-counts placeholder detailed/brief artifacts through those semantic counters. The added tests only prove semantic text wins when both semantic and placeholder text exist (`tests/token-accounting/materialized-representation-counter.test.ts:190-247`, `tests/token-accounting/openai-input-token-counter.test.ts:383-438`); they do not close the forbidden placeholder-only runtime path.

productionPathFindings: Semantic lower-band runtime helpers/counters still preserve a placeholder compatibility path instead of enforcing semantic-artifact-only accounting.
additionalObservations: `npm run verify` passed locally (480 passing tests) and included the real provider-backed lower-band tests in `tests/thread/lower-band-compression-provider-backed.test.ts`.

The lower-band compression service itself otherwise matches the Story 4 retry/escalation and lean-artifact requirements: attempts 1/2 stay on the routed lane, attempt 3 escalates to GPT-5.5 medium and is accepted, ready artifacts stay lean, and failure state/logging are covered by tests.
